description:
Convierte montos de tokens entre decimal y unidades base enteras de forma exacta (USDC 6 decimales, ETH 18…), como en x402. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: estimar el costo de llamadas a un LLM a partir de tokens (llm-cost-estimate). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Converts a token amount between decimal and integer base units exactly (BigInt), e.g. USDC (6 decimals) 1.5 ↔ 1500000, ETH (18) or any decimals 0-36, as used in x402 payment requirements. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Converts a token amount between decimal and integer base units exactly (BigInt), e.g. USDC (6 decimals) 1.5 ↔ 1500000, ETH (18) or any decimals 0-36, as used in x402 payment requirements. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: estimating LLM request cost from input/output token counts (llm-cost-estimate). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

amount.description: Decimal amount (to base units) (string; optional; up to 80 chars).

base_units.description: Integer base units (to decimal) (string; optional; pattern ^\d{1,80}$).

decimals.description: Token decimals (USDC = 6) (integer; optional; default 6; min 0; max 36).

name: token-units-convert
title: Monto de token ↔ unidades base
